notes: ACCESS: clean. probe.fetch() returned HTTP 200 on every request across rotating fingerprints (firefox133, chrome131, safari18_0_ios, safari18_0); no WAF, no challenge, no 403, no 429, no reader prefix or alternate profile set needed. Pages are server-rendered React (0.5-1.0 MB) carrying the full listing payload inline, so no API host and no browser automation were needed. Single host throughout (www.hoeffner.de), so no second robots.txt was owed. ROBOTS: https://www.hoeffner.de/robots.txt fetched FIRST (HTTP 200, firefox133) before any other request and read in full. It is eight lines long and contains exactly ONE user-agent group: 'User-agent: *' with 'Disallow: /warenkorb', 'Disallow: /kundenkonto', 'Disallow: /bestellung', 'Disallow: /newsletter-einstellungen', 'Disallow: /stoffmuster-', 'Disallow: /konfigurator', 'Disallow: /passwort/aendern', 'Disallow: /*.htm$'. There is NO group naming ClaudeBot, Claude-Web, anthropic-ai, Claude-User or Claude-SearchBot anywhere in the file, so no Claude opt-out exists, and there is no Crawl-delay and no Sitemap directive (probe.py's 2 s per-host gap was kept anyway). Category listing pages are bare first-level slugs (/badezimmer, /badaccessoires, /sanitaer-armaturen ...) and none of them ends in .htm, so nothing disallowed was requested: no cart, no account, no order, no newsletter-settings, no fabric-sample, no configurator, no password path, and no .htm URL. Colour and brand facet URLs of the shape /badezimmer__weiss and /badezimmer_joop exist on the site and are technically allowed, but none was requested and none is recorded (rules 25, 27). The only multi-segment URLs touched were plain pagination (/badaccessoires/2) and the series overview /serien/badezimmer. TREE: taken from the site's own navigation, three sources cross-checked. (1) The homepage renders the complete mega-menu server-side; 437 labelled links were extracted, of which the 'Bad' flyout gives the department in the site's own order: Bad (/badezimmer) > Bad-Hochschränke, Bad-Hängeschränke, Badmöbel-Sets, Waschplätze, Spiegelschränke, Waschbeckenunterschränke, Bad-Unterschränke, Badezimmerspiegel, Waschtische, Badregale, Zubehör (/badaccessoires) > WC-Zubehör, Seifenspender, Handtuchhalter, Zahnputzbecher, Seifenschalen, Textilien (/badtextilien) > Handtücher & Badetücher, Handtuch-Sets, Badematten & Badvorleger, Sonstiges. (2) The mega-menu TRUNCATES the Zubehör branch: the /badaccessoires PLP carries its own on-page child carousel which adds two further children the menu omits - Badaccessoire-Sets (/badaccessoire-sets, 1) and Badspiegel (/badspiegel) - plus a Dusch- & Badewannenzubehör entry that turns out to be an alias of the parent. Both genuine additions were followed; Badaccessoire-Sets is recorded and would have been silently lost from the menu alone. (3) The /badezimmer PLP carries a second carousel of six SEO landing pages (Badezimmer Dekoration, -Textilien, -Schränke, -Lampen, -Utensilien, -Regale), every one of which was fetched and adjudicated in review[]; two of them (-Schränke, -Regale) simply serve the Bad department page and two more (-Utensilien, -Textilien) are re-cuts of nodes already recorded or routed. Höffner sells no showers, shower enclosures, screens, bath tubs, WCs or bidets - the mega-menu, the Bad department page and every related-category block were scanned for dusch|wanne|wc|toilette|bidet|armatur|sanitaer and the only hits are WC-Zubehör (WC seats and brush sets, recorded), /sanitaer-armaturen (wash basins, recorded) and the alias above - so rules 5, 6 and 7 have no counterpart in this catalogue and nothing was skipped. QTY: every figure is the listing page's OWN rendered German total, read as '<N> Ergebnisse' in the results bar and independently confirmed by the inline payload's totalCount on the same response; the two agreed on all 30 pages fetched. PAGE SIZE PROVEN AT 72 AND THE TOTALS PROVEN TO BE TRUE TOTALS, three ways: (a) the payload's own numberOfPages is exactly ceil(totalCount/72) on every node checked - Badzubehör 111/2, Badtextilien 579/9, Badschränke 1248/18, Bad 4260/60, Badezimmerspiegel 40/1; (b) page 1 of /badaccessoires renders exactly 72 distinct articleNo values and /badaccessoires/2 renders exactly 39, 72+39 = 111 = the rendered total, i.e. enumerated to exhaustion on a paginated node; (c) every recorded leaf is under 72 and returns numberOfPages 1, so none of the recorded figures can be a page-size artifact. Counts discriminate strongly across the whole tree (1, 2, 5, 6, 8, 11, 12, 17, 22, 32, 40, 46, 47, 67, 74, 78, 83, 111, 130, 149, 152, 237, 250, 262, 482, 570, 579, 955, 1248, 1550, 4260). NOTE ON THE META TAG: each page also carries a meta description of the form 'X Artikel verfügbar im Shop' whose number is consistently HIGHER than the rendered total (Bad 8092 vs 4260, Badspiegel 59 vs 40, Zahnputzbecher 12 vs 11) because it counts variants and out-of-stock articles. It was deliberately NOT used - this is exactly the nav-attribute trap the brief warns about, and every recorded figure comes from the listing's own rendered results bar instead. Every recorded page's H1 was checked against the node requested and matched (Badezimmerspiegel, Waschtische, WC-Zubehör, Seifenspender, Handtuchhalter, Zahnputzbecher, Seifenschalen, Badaccessoire-Sets). No number was estimated, no parent number reused, no siblings summed - note the Badzubehör children total 94 against a parent of 111, which is why the parent is a blank grouping row. CLASSIFICATION CALLS: /sanitaer-armaturen is recorded despite the menu label 'Waschtische' because its six products are ceramic and glass WASH BASINS (Keramik-Doppelwaschtisch Capri, Bad-Keramik-Waschtisch Bodensee, Keramik-Waschbecken Fährsee, Glaswaschtisch Alba) - rule 4 sanitaryware, and a genuinely different node from the already-extracted furniture node Waschplätze (47). /badezimmer-spiegel is recorded as Bathroom, not Lighting, even though several of its mirrors advertise 'inkl. LED-Beleuchtung': primary product type is mirror (rule 11), and the site's separate Badezimmer Lampen node (955) is routed to Lighting. DEDUP: dedup.already_extracted() was run on all 36 candidate and control URLs before anything was recorded. Höffner is very heavily represented in the index (140 hoeffner.de rows, all Furniture.xlsx), and ELEVEN of the hits are bathroom nodes - bad-hochschraenke, bad-midischraenke, bad-unterschraenke, bad-wandschraenke, badezimmer-spiegelschraenke, badhocker, badregale, komplett-badkombinationen, waschbeckenunterschraenke, waschplaetze, waschmaschinenschraenke. Every one of them is in review[] and none is in rows[]: under OPTION 1 the entire Badmöbel half of this department stays in Furniture, which is why only the fixtures, mirrors and accessories come through here. All eight recorded leaves plus both grouping URLs are clean of the index. VERDICT: BATHROOM FOUND - 8 leaves, 100 products, under Bad > (Badezimmerspiegel, Waschtische) and Bad > Badzubehör; bathroom furniture left in Furniture.xlsx, bath textiles routed to Textile, bathroom lighting to Lighting, bathroom decor to Decor.
